page: Microsoft Azure E248ds_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the Edsv7 server family. Powered by an x86_64 Intel processor and managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this instance features 248 dedicated virtual CPUs. It is equipped with 1888.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 7.61 GB of RAM per core. The hardware configuration does not include any graphics processing units.

For storage-intensive operations, the E248ds_v7 includes 15118 GB of local storage and supports Premium Storage options. This high-capacity local disk space allows for rapid read and write operations directly on the host. The instance does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses, meaning external networking must be configured separately.

Given its high resource density, the E248ds_v7 offers qualitative cost efficiency for enterprise workloads requiring massive memory footprints and substantial local storage without the overhead of dedicated GPU accelerators. The combination of 248 vCPUs, 1.8 TB of RAM, and over 15 TB of local storage makes this server type highly suitable for large-scale relational databases, in-memory analytics, enterprise resource planning systems, and heavy data warehousing tasks.
